title: Flame’s Vanilla+ Modpack
description: A lightweight vanilla-plus modpack that improves the base game without changing its feel. It focuses on better visuals, smoother performance, and useful quality-of-life features.
body:
## Flame’s Vanilla+ Modpack

Vanilla Minecraft, but cleaner, smoother, and better looking.

A lightweight vanilla-plus modpack focused on improving the base game while keeping the original feel. It improves visuals, boosts performance, and adds small quality-of-life changes without altering core gameplay.

## Main Features

- Improved visuals with better lighting, particles, and animations
- Shader support for enhanced graphics
- Performance optimization mods for smoother gameplay
- Cleaner UI and HUD improvements
- Small quality-of-life improvements
- New structures and world details
- Included visual resource packs

## Future Plans

- More visual improvements
- Additional performance optimizations
- Better sound and immersion features
- More optional profiles and config presets

## Important Notice

Updating YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) may break the pack.  
Keep the version at 3.8.0 unless the modpack updates it.

Some keybinds in this modpack are different from default Minecraft.  
You can change them if you want, but the included keybinds are recommended for the best experience.

## Beta Notice

This modpack is currently in beta. Bugs, crashes, or unfinished features may occur. Updates will continue to improve stability and add more content.
